recognize_zh: 這是頸部下段／胸廓入口的軸切 CT，箭頭指向右側頸動脈鞘外側的軟組織密度結節，符合腫大淋巴結；影像只能指出病灶位置與大小，無法做淋巴瘤分型或分級。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced CT at the level of the thoracic inlet/lower neck
Arrow marks a rounded soft-tissue-density nodule in the right lower cervical region lateral to the enhancing great vessels
Homogeneous attenuation without evident necrosis or calcification
Trachea midline; clavicles and vertebral body are in the plane of section
describe_en: Axial contrast-enhanced CT image through the lower neck at the level of the clavicles shows a rounded, homogeneous soft-tissue-density nodule in the right lower cervical region (arrow), lateral to the enhancing carotid and jugular vessels, consistent with an enlarged lymph node. There is no visible central necrosis or calcification, and the trachea remains midline. Imaging documents the site of nodal disease but cannot establish histologic type or grade, which require tissue biopsy.
